description: Render real GPU-composited JPEG screenshots of the live project timeline at specified timestamps (and optional normalized 0..1 region crop) — the Levea equivalent of ffmpeg frame extraction, showing all video layers, captions, title cards, color grades, masks, and VFX shaders. Returns native MCP image blocks so you can visually inspect the frames before calling EXPORT_VIDEO.

region.description: Optional normalized zoom region { x, y, width, height } in 0..1 coordinates.

timestamps.description: Timeline timestamps in seconds to capture (e.g. [1.0, 5.0, 12.0]).

name: render_preview
title: Render GPU preview screenshots
